catalog.method: POST fixed URL, body hash=xsandokUpdatex, Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, User-Agent Go-http-client/1.1; body is one Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope (password P17, fallback P32); decrypt_catalog_full then decrypts every individually-encrypted field
catalog.notes: HONEST LIMIT: 21 values in 15 networks do NOT decrypt with any key in the APK (the key is not in the APK). They are kept verbatim and the result carries decryptionStatus {complete: false, unresolvedFields: 21, locations: [...]} (locations only, never raw values); the engine and gateway mark the catalog partial.

files.method: Base64 Argon2id + AES-256-GCM envelope (same family as the catalog)
